name: Client campaign performance report
summary: At the weekly or monthly reporting cutoff, the analyst gets a client report in the agency's format from the exports supplied: source figures, a drafted narrative, anomalies and discussion points. Gaps stay gaps, and every explanation is labelled a hypothesis.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of agency work for marketing and advertising, the illustrative piece of work of assembling the client performance report, written up here as a self-contained workflow template.
